crops.name: Maize (Mahindi)
crops.soil_preferences: Deep, well-drained loamy to sandy clay loam soils rich in organic matter. Sensitive to waterlogging.
crops.ph_preference: 5.8 - 7.0 (growth severely stunted below pH 5.0 due to aluminium toxicity)
crops.drainage_preference: Good drainage essential; water stagnation causes yellowing and stunted rooting within 48 hours.

nutrient_requirements.description: High nitrogen needed for vegetative vigor and cob fill; high phosphorus critical at planting for root establishment.

crops.planting_guidance: Plant 2 seeds per hole at 75cm between rows and 25cm between hills, or 75cm x 50cm for 2 plants. Plant at onset of steady rains.
common_deficiencies: Zinc (broad bleached bands on young leaves)
crops.harvest_info: Harvest when husks dry and brown, kernel moisture drops below 14% to prevent aflatoxin contamination.
crops.kenya_notes: Staple food across Western, Rift Valley, Central, and Eastern Kenya. Acidic soils in Western and North Rift often require agricultural lime (calcitic/dolomitic) before applying mineral fertilizers.

crops.name: Common Beans (Maharage)
crops.soil_preferences: Fertile, well-drained loams. Highly sensitive to saline soils and standing water.
crops.ph_preference: 6.0 - 6.8 (Rhizobia nitrogen fixation drops sharply below pH 5.5)
crops.drainage_preference: Requires very well-drained soil. Waterlogging causes rapid root rot and damping off.

nutrient_requirements.description: Fixes atmospheric nitrogen through symbiotic nodules; requires adequate phosphorus for nodule development and flowering.

crops.planting_guidance: Plant at 45cm row spacing and 10-15cm within row at a depth of 3-5cm. Inoculation with Biofix rhizobium recommended.
common_deficiencies: Phosphorus (dark green stunted foliage, poor flowering)
crops.harvest_info: Harvest when pods are dry and rattle. Dry thoroughly on clean tarpaulins to below 13% moisture.
crops.kenya_notes: Common varieties: Rosecoco (GLP-2), Mwitemania (GLP-X92), Red Haricot, Nyayo. Ideal intercrop with maize.

crops.name: Tomatoes (Nyanya)
crops.soil_preferences: Deep, crumbly loam with abundant decomposed organic matter. High water retention with excellent drainage.
crops.ph_preference: 6.0 - 6.8 (calcium uptake impaired at low pH, leading to blossom end rot)
crops.drainage_preference: Must have excellent drainage. Prone to bacterial wilt in waterlogged heavy clay.

nutrient_requirements.description: Potassium essential for fruit firmness, shape, and sugar content; Calcium critical for blossom end rot prevention.

crops.planting_guidance: Sow in nursery beds; transplant strong seedlings after 3-4 weeks at 60cm x 45cm spacing with well-cured compost.
common_deficiencies: Calcium (Blossom End Rot at base of fruit)
crops.harvest_info: Harvest at breaker or pink stage for transport; harvest fully red for immediate local consumption.
crops.kenya_notes: Grown extensively in Kirinyaga, Kajiado, Machakos, and Uasin Gishu. Rotate with non-solanaceous crops to avoid bacterial wilt buildup.

crops.name: Sukuma Wiki (Collard Greens)
crops.growth_duration_days: 45 - 60 days to first picking; harvests for 6+ months
crops.water_requirement: Regular, steady moisture; drought causes bitter tough leaves
crops.soil_preferences: Moisture-retentive loamy soils enriched with organic manure. Tolerates moderate clay if well aerated.
crops.ph_preference: 6.0 - 7.5 (susceptible to clubroot disease in strongly acidic soils below pH 5.5)

nutrient_requirements.description: High continuous nitrogen demand for rapid, tender green leaf production across repeated cuttings.

crops.planting_guidance: Transplant 4-week-old nursery seedlings at 45cm x 45cm or 60cm x 45cm. Top-dress with well-rotted manure or CAN after each major picking.
crops.harvest_info: Pick outer mature leaves progressively every 7 to 10 days, leaving the central growing apex intact.
crops.kenya_notes: Universal household food security vegetable. Popular varieties: Thousand Headed, Southern Georgia. Sensitive to water stress.

crops.name: Irish Potatoes (Viazi Mviringo)
crops.water_requirement: 500 - 700 mm; sensitive to drought during tuber bulking
crops.soil_preferences: Loose, friable sandy loam or volcanic loam with good aeration. Dense compacted soil leads to deformed tubers.
crops.ph_preference: 5.2 - 6.2 (slightly acidic; higher pH above 6.5 increases common scab severity)
crops.drainage_preference: Strictly well-drained. Heavy waterlogging leads to tuber rotting within 24-48 hours.

nutrient_requirements.description: High potassium requirement for starch accumulation and disease resistance; phosphorus aids early root and stolon vigor.

crops.planting_guidance: Use certified sprouted seed tubers (size 35-45mm). Plant in furrows 75cm apart with 30cm between tubers. Ridge up at 15-20cm vegetative height.
common_deficiencies: Potassium (marginal necrosis, hollow heart in rapid growth)
crops.harvest_info: Dehaulm (cut foliage) 10-14 days before harvest to allow skin setting, preventing skinning and storage rotting.
crops.kenya_notes: Major production in Nyandarua, Meru, Nakuru, Elgeyo Marakwet, and Narok. Certified seed availability is key to controlling bacterial wilt.

crops.name: Bulb Onions (Kitunguu Maji)
crops.water_requirement: 350 - 550 mm; withdraw water 2-3 weeks before harvest
crops.soil_preferences: Friable, stone-free sandy loam or silt loam. Heavy soils impede bulb expansion.
crops.drainage_preference: High drainage required; sensitive to waterlogging which triggers bulb rots.

nutrient_requirements.description: Phosphorus aids shallow root systems; excessive late nitrogen delays bulb maturity and causes thick necks.

crops.planting_guidance: Transplant pencilsized seedlings at 30cm between rows and 10cm within rows. Keep bulb base shallow.
common_deficiencies: Sulfur (weak pungent smell and pale color)
common_pests: Onion Thrips (Thrips tabaci) - major dry-season pest
crops.harvest_info: Harvest when 50-70% of foliage tops collapse and bend over. Field-cure thoroughly in shade.
crops.kenya_notes: Grown in Kajiado (Loitokitok), Naivasha, Taveta, and Nyeri. Popular varieties: Red Pinoy, Bombay Red, Red Creole.

crops.name: Hass Avocado (Parachichi)
crops.growth_duration_days: 2.5 - 3 years to first fruit; productive for 25+ years
crops.water_requirement: 1000 - 1200 mm annual rainfall or supplemental drip
crops.soil_preferences: Deep (>1.5m), well-aerated volcanic loams. Highly sensitive to saline soils and compaction.
crops.drainage_preference: Extremely sensitive to poor drainage. Phytophthora cinnamomi root rot kills trees in poorly drained clay.

nutrient_requirements.description: High potassium and boron requirements during fruit set and fruit development.

crops.planting_guidance: Dig 60x60x60cm holes, mix topsoil with 20kg well-decomposed manure. Plant grafted seedlings at 5m x 5m or 6m x 6m spacing.
crops.spacing: 5 m x 5 m (or 6 m x 6 m)
crops.harvest_info: Harvest mature fruits with clipping shears leaving a short pedicel; do not pull by hand.
crops.kenya_notes: Major export earner in Murang'a, Kiambu, Meru, Kisii, and Nyamira. Requires organic mulch around drip line.

crops.name: Sorghum (Mtama)
crops.soil_preferences: Wide adaptability; thrives on clay loams, vertisols (black cotton soil), and sandy soils.
crops.ph_preference: 5.5 - 8.5 (highly tolerant of moderate soil salinity and alkalinity)
crops.drainage_preference: Tolerates temporary waterlogging far better than maize.

nutrient_requirements.description: Extensive root system scavenges residual soil nutrients efficiently.

crops.planting_guidance: Sow in rows 60-75cm apart, thin to 15-20cm within rows. Ideal for semi-arid counties.
crops.harvest_info: Harvest panicles when grain is hard and black layer forms at seed attachment point.
crops.kenya_notes: Ideal climate-resilient crop for Eastern (Kitui, Machakos, Makueni), Coast, and lower Nyanza.

crops.name: Green Grams / Ndengu
crops.soil_preferences: Well-drained sandy loam or alluvial soils.
crops.drainage_preference: Good drainage needed; cannot tolerate soggy root zones.

nutrient_requirements.description: Atmospheric nitrogen fixer. Responsive to phosphorus micro-dosing at planting.

crops.planting_guidance: Plant at 45cm x 15cm at onset of short rains. Varieties: KS20, Biashara, N26.
common_deficiencies: Iron chlorosis in high pH soils
crops.harvest_info: Hand-pick pods when they turn black/dark brown before shattering occurs.
crops.kenya_notes: Economic lifeline for Kitui, Makueni, Tharaka Nithi, and Embu semi-arid lowlands.
